Boundaries.Name: pubsub-notification-activation
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow activation ownership through coverage discovery, every endpoint, topology catch-up and rollback.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-notification-route
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the activation or reconciliation owner through control replies and rejected-route removal.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-notification-reconciliation
Boundaries.Contract: Each background subscription reconciliation has an internal failure-only owner through every endpoint and rollback. Subscription shutdown produces no observation.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-notification-reconciliation-route
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow either the pending activation owner or independent internal reconciliation owner through new-route fan-out and uncertain-socket cleanup.
